description: Public polls on Power Players with each option's votes and share of the vote, the total, the scope (national, state, district or local), the end date, and the sponsor's name when a sponsor paid for it. status is 'active' (default), 'completed' or 'all'; a two-letter state returns that state's polls plus national ones. Votes come from members who chose to answer: not a scientific or representative poll, so never present a result as public opinion.
name: list_polls
title: List polls
